manuscript.recommendation_en: Major revision is required before the deployment claim can be evaluated.
manuscript.recommendation_zh: 在能够评估部署结论之前，稿件需要进行实质性大修。

issues.title_en: The image-level split does not establish sequence independence
issues.title_zh: 图像级拆分没有建立序列独立性
issues.evidence_en: Eight temporally related images from one specimen are randomly split into training and test images.
issues.evidence_zh: 来自同一试件的八张时间相关图像被随机拆分到训练集和测试集。
issues.impact_en: Near-duplicate temporal content can inflate the reported accuracy and cannot support generalization to unseen structures.
issues.impact_zh: 时间上高度相似的内容可能抬高准确率，无法支持对未见结构的泛化结论。
issues.required_action_en: Use specimen- or sequence-level holdout and report results on a genuinely independent test set.
issues.required_action_zh: 采用试件级或序列级留出，并在真正独立的测试集上报告结果。

issues.title_en: The deployment claim lacks uncertainty and repeated-run evidence
issues.title_zh: 部署结论缺少不确定性和重复运行证据
issues.evidence_en: The manuscript reports one accuracy value without confidence intervals, repeated seeds, or an external test set.
issues.evidence_zh: 稿件只报告一个准确率，没有置信区间、多随机种子或外部测试集。
issues.impact_en: The magnitude and stability of the claimed performance are unknown.
issues.impact_zh: 所声称性能的幅度和稳定性均不明确。
issues.required_action_en: Report repeated runs, uncertainty intervals, and an external or specimen-level test.
issues.required_action_zh: 报告重复运行、不确定性区间以及外部或试件级测试。

strengths_en: The manuscript states a concrete deployment-oriented objective.
strengths_zh: 稿件提出了明确的部署导向目标。
acceptance_gate_zh: 采用序列独立的数据拆分。
报告重复运行与不确定性。

evidence.claim: Eight temporally related images from one specimen are randomly split into training and test images, and one accuracy is reported.

summary_en: The manuscript claims a deployment-ready tracker from an eight-image, image-level split.
summary_zh: 稿件根据八张图像的图像级拆分声称跟踪器已可部署。

text.primary: The paper reports 95% accuracy on two held-out images from the same specimen and concludes the method is ready for unseen structures.

translations.zh-Hans: 论文在同一试件的两张留出图像上报告 95% 准确率，并认为方法可用于未见结构。

text.primary: The manuscript states a concrete deployment-oriented objective.

translations.zh-Hans: 稿件提出了明确的部署导向目标。

text.primary: The evaluation does not establish sequence independence, so the deployment claim is unsupported.

translations.zh-Hans: 评估没有建立序列独立性，因此部署结论缺少支持。

text.primary: What is the specimen-level accuracy, with repeated seeds, on a genuinely held-out sequence?

translations.zh-Hans: 在真正留出的序列上，带重复种子的试件级准确率是多少？

rationale.primary: The tracking objective is concrete but the method is not compared to prior work in this fixture.
Deployment-oriented tracking is a real need; the fixture does not measure community impact.
The deployment claim is not supported by the reported split or uncertainty.
Image-level split of eight temporally related images is not an independent test.
The short synthetic manuscript is readable and internally consistent.
A cautionary evaluation example has some teaching value but no released protocol.
The manuscript itself contains no related-work discussion; only a fixture snapshot is attached.
